reviewed_change.reason: Review follow-up on the managed-workspace ownership release: 20261112250000 adds the stored generated column channel_payout_records.workspace_key and a unique index on (manager_user_id, platform, confirmation_code, kind, workspace_key), replacing the owner-level channel_payout_records_key so a booking record is identified inside its own workspace and an import can no longer re-point an existing row to another workspace. Derived column and index only: no new table, no column dropped, no grant or policy change, and the purge classification of channel_payout_records (phase 2, manager_user_id) is unchanged. Managed-workspace ownership release: adds channel_payout_records and channel_finance_mail (20261112220000; Airbnb/Booking.com payout evidence and forwarded finance mail) and managed_workspace_ownership_moves (20261112230000; mover audit, single-apply marker, undo record). All service-role-only (RLS on, no client grants); the two channel tables are classified in the account purge manifest (phase 2, manager_user_id purged with the account) and absent from the historical dev catalog snapshot, which is unchanged; the move audit is in ACCOUNT_PURGE_RETAINED (ids only, deletion guarded by managed-account-deletion-guard.server.ts). Earlier 2026-11-12 additions (preapply checks, adverse actions, ratings, prospect spine, stay_message_sends) stand.
